title: Quick Tip: Business Central Launch Edition 2026 Wave 1: 37 Sessions
summary: The Business Central Launch Edition for 2026 Wave 1 provides 37 free video sessions covering the latest features across Copilot and AI, reporting, supply chain, finance, development, Shopify integration, and administration released on April 1, 2026.
key_points: 37 sessions totaling under 10 hours of free training content available at aka.ms/BCLE
New Payables Agent and Business Central integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio for AI capabilities
Enhanced analytics across Power BI, Excel, inventory, sales, and subscription billing
New features including Quality Management, self-billing invoices, withholding taxes, and Shopify connector
Development improvements with AL Language enhancements, Visual Studio Code test running, and MCP Server capabilities

quotes.text: Thirty-seven sessions, just under ten hours, all free at aka.ms/BCLE.
